title: Bind summary fields and text passages to exact source citations
context: Derived summaries cited dependencies as a whole, leaving readers unable to identify which source supported an individual field or sentence. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.); con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Add optional field-level provenance for exact scalar fields and Unicode text passages, with source-bound hashes and shared read display, negotiated through nuryel.field-provenance/1.
consequences: Readers can trace individual summary fields and passages to their supporting sources.
Clients must negotiate the field-provenance capability before using it.
The capability remains in development for the next release.

evidence: agent-review: helpers were moved and re-exported, not retired; node:fs remains in use
